chapter: Germany, Paris and return to America
title: Falling off the stand while hitting the high note
summary: Waters recalls playing the 'St. James Infirmary' high note on clarinet at the Cigalle, drunk, and falling off the stand without missing it, and a similar fall in a New York theater show.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: OK, Benny, I'd like you to try to think back over the last 10, 12, 13 years in context of Europe and tell me what you think are the memorable highlights for your playing career.
Oh, remember, you mean the things that I - yeah, I see. In where, in Europe or -

In Europe. Well (laughs), one thing that I'll never forget - I was playing clarinet one time, used to do a little specialty on the clarinet, one time at the Cigalle. And I was drinkin' all that whiskey, I was playin' the 'St. James Infirmary', slow but I was makin' this high note on the end, you know, see. I could do it, make a note even higher than I do right now, see, because I, like I lost my mouthpiece and clarinet here in New York a few years ago. So anyway - well, I made this note, I was drunk. I fell off the stand and the stand is that high, you know. I fell off the stand and landed right on [ ], you know what I mean? But I made the note with one hand in the air like that. And I didn't break the clarinet and I made the note and I didn't hurt myself, you know? So the [ ], the
boss on the place laughed into tears (laughs), he laughed into tears. But that's one thing I'll never, never forget. And he -
He wanted you to put it in the act, huh?
Yeah (PS laughs), well that - no, that didn't happen in, that didn't happen there, that's why they didn't want me [to] stay in Germany. That didn't happen in France -

here in - no, in New York, in, and I did the same thing. But if I - I was drinking too - but I didn't fall off or nothing. I tell you who was in the band, Frankie Newton was in the band after that. So I was makin' these little [ ] that I used to play, and I, at that time the people make high notes, you know. And I was saying "Dah", and they build it up that way, "Dah". And every time I'd make higher I'd go back, you know what I mean? That, it was - so when I made the climax of the note I fell right down again, you know (PS laughs). So this guy, the manager of the theater, came running out and I, success that I am, I take about three bows, you know - you have, the curtain closes and opens, you know? "Great", "successful", "fantastic". So this manager of the theater heard all this noise and applause that I was gettin' there, and so he saw it. He saw it, that first thing, he saw it, he saw that, the way I fell. He says "Keep that in (PS laughs), keep that it, Benny", he wanted me to do that every show. So I told him, so I says "No, I'm not gonna hurt myself, you know, on account" - I didn't tell him exactly that, you know, but I told him, see, "I'm not gonna fall on my butt every show (laughs) like that for you". 'Cause I said that was an accident. He says "Good, that's good!" (PS laughs). But always in France I fell off the stand, you know, I just fell off the stand -
Uh huh. Still hit the note, though (laughs).
I hit the note, yeah, yeah.
